Petition: Lift the ban on gay men donating blood in the USA

Many people are not aware of the current federal ban on gay men donating blood. I know that I was not aware of it until I was enlisted, and tried to give blood at one of the mobile blood donation programs for the US Army. I have O- type blood, arguably the most valuable blood type, as O- blood can be given to any person, regardless of the recipient's type. I went in to the mobile blood donation center to give blood to this Army program that ships the blood overseas and uses it to treat ISAF and other combat casualties. Once my blood had been drawn and packaged, the attending nurse asked me several disqualifying questions.

Have you received any vaccinations for disease within the last 8 weeks? No. Have you ever had any sexually transmitted diseases? No. Are you currently taking antibiotics for any infections? No. Have you ever had sexual intercourse with another man? ...Yes. Does that matter?

Apparently, it does. I, an American soldier, was barred from donating blood that could have helped saved the life of one of my comrades wounded in battle. Because of my sexuality, they had to dispose of the blood that had been drawn. It's a pretty despical practice.
That's shitty! On top of being ignorant bigots, you think they'd ask you those questions before going all Dracula on your arm.
I am always surprised at the question. I understand the concerns over contamination of the blood supply, but seriously the science and testing has progressed since the rules were adopted.
